wrangler: pack name, the Cloudflare Workers CLI whose configuration this reads
kv_namespaces: Wrangler: the block binding Workers KV namespaces
r2_buckets: Wrangler: the block binding R2 buckets
d1_databases: Wrangler: the block binding D1 databases
id: Wrangler: the KV namespace a binding points at
bucket_name: Wrangler: the R2 bucket a binding points at
database_name: Wrangler: the D1 database a binding points at
producers: Wrangler: the queues a Worker sends on
consumers: Wrangler: the queues a Worker drains
file: suss: marker for a configuration document this reader found
missing: suss: marker for a path with no configuration document under it
worker: suss: deployment target, an edge worker
default: suss: the storage scope a store with no namespace of its own takes
codeUri: suss: marker for a code scope a manifest states
template: suss: marker for a value the document states
globals: suss: marker for a value a document-level default states
declared: suss: confidence source for a fact a manifest states
partial: suss: a storage contract that declares some of an item's fields
none: suss: a storage contract that declares none of an item's fields
queues: Wrangler: the block declaring the queues a Worker sends on and drains
